data.long_meaning: Sharvi means 'victorious' and Kaman means 'god'. This name signifies a god of victory or a powerful deity. The name Sharvikaman carries the meaning “God of victory, powerful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharvikaman usually hope their child will grow to embody god of victory, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
